name: 127. Mirrored reasoning shorthand + object accepted when values agree (#7659 / PR #7648) (mirrored-reasoning)
description:
Issue #7659 / PR #7648: ChatParameters.UnmarshalJSON (core/schemas/chatcompletions.go) rejected any request carrying the same reasoning directive in both spellings - the flat reasoning_effort shorthand and reasoning.effort - and the native handler surfaced that as a generic 400 "Invalid request payload" before routing or logging (routing_info: {}). Agents built on ai-sdk (ZCode 3.14.x / provider-utils 4.0.39) emit every vendor dialect at once for reasoning-capable models (reasoning_effort + reasoning.effort + thinking + enable_thinking), so every reasoning turn failed with retryable=false. Each field alone always decoded fine; only the mirrored pair tripped the check.

The fix accepts equal duplicates (canonicalizing onto the reasoning object, as the existing merge already did) for the effort, max_tokens and display pairs, and keeps rejecting contradictory values so a request asking for two different efforts is still a hard error instead of a silent winner-pick.

Cases: (1) native /v1/chat/completions with the exact ai-sdk dialect body, non-streaming -> 200 with content (pre-fix 400 Invalid request payload); (2) same, streaming -> SSE with text deltas; (3) the /openai drop-in, which is what OpenAI-SDK-based agents actually hit, with the mirrored pair -> 200; (4) anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 with the mirrored reasoning_max_tokens + reasoning.max_tokens pair, pinning the second union pair on a wire that consumes the budget; (5) [EXPECT-400] contradictory reasoning_effort high vs reasoning.effort low -> the gateway still returns 400 Invalid request payload, pinning the protective intent. The unknown ai-sdk keys (thinking, enable_thinking) are dropped on the native route because x-bf-passthrough-extra-params is not set.

exec: pm.test('openai/gpt-5-mini ai-sdk dialect (reasoning_effort + reasoning.effort equal) reaches the provider - #7659', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'mirrored reasoning pair was rejected before routing (pre-fix 400 Invalid request payload): ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(200);
var t = pm.response.text();
pm.expect(t, 'gateway-side decode rejection leaked: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.not.include('Invalid request payload');
pm.expect(t, 'gateway-side conflict rejection leaked: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.not.include('conflicts with');
var j = pm.response.json();
var msg = j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message;
pm.expect(msg && typeof msg.content === 'string' && msg.content.length > 0, 'expected assistant text content: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.equal(true);
pm.expect(j.usage && typeof j.usage.completion_tokens === 'number', 'expected usage on the reply: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.equal(true);

item.name: openai openai/gpt-5-mini /v1/chat/completions mirrored reasoning_effort + reasoning.effort (equal, ai-sdk dialect) accepted (non-streaming) - #7659

exec: pm.test('openai/gpt-5-mini mirrored reasoning pair streams normally - #7659', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'mirrored reasoning pair was rejected before routing (pre-fix 400 Invalid request payload): ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(200);
var raw = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || ''), 'expected an SSE stream: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.include('text/event-stream');
pm.expect(raw, 'gateway-side decode rejection leaked: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.not.include('Invalid request payload');
var content = '';
raw.split('\n').forEach(function (l) {
if (l.indexOf('data: ') !== 0 || l.indexOf('[DONE]') !== -1) { return; }
var ev; try { ev = JSON.parse(l.slice(6)); } catch (e) { return; }
var d = ev.choices && ev.choices[0] && ev.choices[0].delta;
if (d && typeof d.content === 'string') { content += d.content; }
pm.expect(content.length, 'expected streamed assistant text, got none: ' + raw.slice(-600)).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(raw, 'expected the [DONE] terminator: ' + raw.slice(-300)).to.include('data: [DONE]');
